info.description: 项目、案例和素材以 libiaolink_case 与独立素材桶为唯一主存。写成功即在同一事务提交，项目目录投影常驻 watch 约 1 秒刷新，客户端可在提交响应后立即读回。

externalProjectId.description: 可选的本地项目 UUID；省略时由案例库生成 UUIDv7，跨核心投影与本地项目全局唯一

projectCode.description: 项目编号：与核心目录可用项跨来源唯一；软删除或源缺失的历史摘要不占编号，归档项仍占用

translationGroupId.description: 同组案例共享此 ID；省略时使用案例 ID，服务端生成案例时使用新的 UUIDv7

solutionParameters.description: 方案组按 solutionType 去重。每组参数名须在对应方案字典内，非空方案组须属于该案例来源项目。

project.externalProjectId: uuid, required, immutable; globally unique across core history and local projects
project.projectCode: string 1..50, required; cross-source unique among available core/local directory entries; PATCH increments sourceVersion
project.managerIds: uuid[], default []; same length as managerNames
project.managerNames: string|null[], default []; same length as managerIds
project.status: active|paused|done|archived; archived sets archivedAt, another status clears it

profile.sourceVersion: project directory sourceVersion; must equal current project version
profile.expectedVersion: profile rowVersion; first save uses 0, success returns 201 then +1
profile.attributes: deliveryYear, customerSubjectId, customerDisplayName, customerAliases, customerLogoAssetId, partnerType, partnerKey, partnerDisplayName, threePlKey, threePlDisplayName, relationshipType, regions, regionCodes, country, countryCode, industry, industryCode, scenarioCode, businessScenario, solutionTypes, canVisit
profile.members: operatorUserKey+roleCode; manager and source fields; optional leftAt

case.translationGroupId: uuid, default caseId; same value links independently editable locales
case.title: string 1..300
case.reviewStatus: not_submitted|reviewing|approved|rejected; caller-owned review mirror, gateway has no review state machine
case.status: derived: deleted > archived > active release published > reviewing > draft
case.rowVersion: integer >=1; increments only on actual change
case.content: schemaVersion=1 fields[] using registered text/highlights keys
case.solutionParameters: schemaVersion=1 groups[] unique solutionType and registered parameter names

asset.caseIds: uuid[]; zero or more links within the same project
asset.title: string 1..300|null
asset.objectVersionId: exact object-store version; no permanent key or credential is exposed
asset.thumbnailAvailable: boolean; image or PDF preview capability

x-write-semantics.idempotency: Every write uses body operationId UUIDv7. The first committed result is retained 30 days; same hash returns the original status/body, different hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
x-write-semantics.immediateRead: Writes and reads use the same case database; after 2xx the committed row is immediately readable. Project core projection uses a resident watch at CASE_PROJECTION_WATCH_MS=1000 by default (250..60000), not a five-minute cycle.
x-write-semantics.optimisticConcurrency: Cases and assets use expectedVersion/rowVersion; local projects use expectedVersion/sourceVersion; conflicts return 409 and never overwrite the newer row.
x-write-semantics.noChange: A PATCH with no actual field change succeeds without incrementing rowVersion or creating a case version.
x-write-semantics.deleteSemantics: Project and case deletes are soft; deleted IDs remain stable. Asset delete is soft and is rejected with 409 ASSET_REFERENCED if any release references the asset; archive remains available. Historical releases are frozen and are not rewritten by later edits, archive, delete, or unlink.
x-write-semantics.upload: Upload sessions expire after 15 minutes; signed PUT targets last at most 120 seconds; parts are 8 MiB; complete re-checks exact objectVersionId, size, MIME signature and SHA-256. Single PUT is used through 32 MiB; multipart up to 256 MiB. Reusing assetId creates a new asset version.
x-write-semantics.mediaResponsibility: External media processor owns scanning, transcoding and thumbnail generation, and writes results only through the assets:process media-state endpoint. Authors can preview images/PDF while scan is pending; scan failure disables preview.
x-write-semantics.errorBody: {code,message,details,traceId}; 409 is recoverable by reading current version/state; 429 and 503 include Retry-After where applicable.

x-migration.notes: Historical migrations are immutable. See the frozen contract report for SHA-256 values and schema diff.
